inputs.commit_message: chore: record ASOL full-proof generator drift [docs-contract-change]
inputs.shell_command:
set -euo pipefail
failures=/tmp/asol-full-proof-failures.$$
: > "$failures"
run_gate(){ name="$1"; shift; echo "===== GATE $name ====="; set +e; "$@"; rc=$?; set -e; echo "GATE:$name:$rc"; if [ $rc -ne 0 ]; then echo "$name:$rc" >> "$failures"; fi; }
echo PROOF_SHA=$(git rev-parse HEAD)
run_gate services_sync npm run services:sync
run_gate verify_all npm run verify:all
run_gate services_build npm run services:build
run_gate account_declarations npm run test:account-declarations
run_gate account_bridge npm run test:account-bridge
run_gate service_bridge npm run test:service-bridge
run_gate service_runtime_core npm run test:service-runtime-core
run_gate vercel_deploy_core npm run test:vercel-deploy-core
run_gate release_core npm run test:release-core
run_gate deployment_tools npm run test:deployment-tools
run_gate compositions npm run test:compositions
run_gate system_logs npm run test:system-logs
run_gate auth_email_uniqueness npm run test:auth-email-uniqueness
run_gate account_deletion_registry npm run test:account-deletion-registry
run_gate cloud_accounts npm run test:cloud-accounts
run_gate runtime_all npm run runtime:check
run_gate runtime_web npm run runtime:check:web
run_gate runtime_static npm run runtime:check:static
run_gate runtime_android npm run runtime:check:android
run_gate runtime_ios npm run runtime:check:ios
run_gate architecture_docs npm run architecture:docs
run_gate architecture_check npm run architecture:check
run_gate docs_generate npm run docs:generate
run_gate docs_ci npm run docs:ci
run_gate control_verify npm run control:verify
run_gate control_build npm run control:build
run_gate control_smoke npm run control:smoke
run_gate gova_tree npm run gova:tree:check
run_gate gova_core npm run test:gova-deployment-core
run_gate api_core npm run test:api-core
run_gate root_build npm run build
echo '--- FINAL STATUS ---'
git status --short
if [ -s "$failures" ]; then echo 'ASOL_FULL_PROOF=FAIL'; cat "$failures"; exit 1; fi
echo ASOL_FULL_PROOF=PASS
